title: Asset's very first trip, pre-start tolerance links a pre-start identification
description: First-trip case, run on a new asset every time, so it's @fresh-asset and opt-in through ALLOW_FRESH_ASSETS. The identification claims atSec -300 (5 minutes before this asset's very first trip starts), inside the design's ten-minute pre-start tolerance, and is delivered live at deliverAtSec 0. This is distinct from O14 in fr-trip-lookup: O14 exercises the trip-END consumer's window, which is floored strictly at trip start with no tolerance; O21 exercises the trip-START consumer's documented pre-start-tolerance fallback, used specifically when there is no previous trip to floor the window against. Must prove: with no previous trip on this asset, the pre-start tolerance links the identification and awards the claim; both assignees become A. Must NOT change: nothing before the trip's own IGN_ON should be observable as a write, since the identification predates it.

driver_identifications.note: 5 minutes before this asset's very first trip starts, inside the ten-minute pre-start tolerance
